name: SKY-001 engineering world model beats frontier LLMs on CAD and BIM
title: SKY-001 engineering world model beats frontier LLMs on CAD and BIM
summary: Skyfall introduced SKY-001 as an engineering world model for CAD and BIM. On those tasks it reports higher IOU than GPT-6 Astra and the other frontier models tested, at 51-125x the speed and 150-210x lower cost.

appearances.title: Skyfall introduces SKY-001 engineering world model
appearances.summary: Skyfall introduced SKY-001, an engineering world model for CAD and BIM that it says beats GPT-6 Astra and other frontier models on intersection-over-union while running 51 to 125 times faster and 150 to 210 times cheaper. It plans each part through 3D intermediate states, sketches, and CAD steps rather than one-shot generation.
